name.value: Coast Coal Harbour Hotel by APA

description.value: Coast Coal Harbour Vancouver Hotel by APA is a modern, full-service hotel on West Hastings Street in Vancouver's Coal Harbour waterfront district, recently renovated with updated rooms. It sits within easy walking distance of Canada Place, Stanley Park, and Gastown, making it a practical base for urban cycling exploration. On-site amenities include an all-day restaurant (Prestons Restaurant + Lounge), a heated outdoor pool and whirlpool open year-round, an exercise gym, and an on-site spa.
